diff --git a/changelog.d/1331.change.md b/changelog.d/1331.change.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7d98994
--- /dev/null
+++ b/changelog.d/1331.change.md
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+`attrs.Converter` now correctly infers the return type of the converter it wraps when it's used in adapter mode -- for example, when it's passed to `attrs.converters.pipe()` (or, equivalently, as part of a list to `attrs.field()`'s / `attr.ib()`'s *converter* argument).
